# Completed hypothesis-probe TODOs

Scope: these are completed **first-probe** tasks. Completion means that the
hypothesis was formalized, tested in a finite or abstract model, assigned a
falsification gate, and audited. It does not mean that the hypothesis was
proved for Yang--Mills theory.

- [x] Freeze a positive two-state bad-extension kernel.
- [x] Construct its exact Perron weight.
- [x] Compare weighted and scalar row ceilings.
- [x] Preserve the hostile row with scalar ceiling one.
- [x] Record that identification with the Yang--Mills vacuum remains open.
